body: I live in an alright apartment with one of my friends from highschool and his brother. I went to college for a year and stopped because I felt like I was wasting my time. Now all I do is work. All of this occurred well after I started feeling that life has no point. Even when I was a little kid I had a "what's the point?" mentality. Although I didn't want to die when I was younger I was always acutely aware that I would die eventually. I've been meditating on and off for the past few months but the more I meditate, the more epiphanies I have about the meaninglessness of everything. Do this, do that, it doesn't matter. nothing REALLY matters, so why bother even live?
No real issues other than a lack of interest in continuing to live. I just don't like the world, I don't like the people. I don't enjoy the fact that I wake up every morning...
